Bob Gurr had his mind set on one thing #Disneyland #DisneyParks #DisneyEats
Disney Legend Bob Gurr, creator and host Garrett Watts, and actress and Disney superfan Yvette Nicole Brown put their senses to the test as they try to identify brand-new 2026 Halloween food and beverages coming to Disneyland Resort. Using their taste, sight, smell, and sound, they'll have to uncover the mystery behind this Halloween season's newest treats before time runs out.

Halloween Time at Disneyland Resort runs from Aug. 21 through Oct. 31, 2026🎃👻

author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
Details We Dig: Treehouse Villas at Disney’s Saratoga Springs Resort | Disney Files On Demand
From the creators of Disney Files Magazine comes the award-winning “Details We Dig,” a Disney Vacation Club series of videos highlighting fun details, legends and backstories around the Disney Vacation Club neighborhood and beyond. This episode focuses its magnifying glass on the re-imagined Treehouse Villas at Disney’s Saratoga Springs Resort. Embracing the rustic elegance of treehouse living, the updated look blends New England-style craftsmanship and the timeless artistry of the Arts and Crafts movement with numerous nods to some familiar Disney friends who feel at home in the forest.
